execution_scope: Source review and disposable mocked regression tests only. No vault provisioning, secret migration, service restart, swap change or tmp mount.

findings.issue: apply did not recheck target state under its lock and could format an existing image on replay; failure cleanup could unlink a prior or still-mapped backing file.
findings.fix: Locked current-state gates, durable single-use claim, O_EXCL creation and fd-based allocation, inode ownership cleanup, retain image when teardown fails or mapper/mount remains, key and lock cleanup on all handled failures.

findings.issue: Rollback could unmount a previous unrelated exact mount and reported legacy exposure without checked teardown.
findings.fix: Only remove the matching candidate bind, verify umount effect, preserve verified legacy seals and block on foreign mounts, report that complete runtime restoration is not attested.
findings.remaining: C5D journal, resource ownership and runtime restoration are covered by the separate C5D source follow-up; live activation still requires operational acceptance.

findings.issue: A failure before cutover invokes global rollback; teardown and restore return codes are ignored; restart policies are not restored; in-memory started flag and reusable plan do not protect an earlier authoritative candidate.
findings.required: Durable attempt journal and ownership of mount/gate/policy mutations, phase-aware rollback, checked teardown and legacy health acceptance, no automatic replay after candidate start attempt.
findings.source_fix: Shared plan/apply lock with fresh authority checks, schema-2 durable attempt journal, permanent candidate-start barrier, inode/mount-ID ownership with checked teardown, full policy restoration including retry limits, actual phase-aware rollback tests and bounded exact-topology legacy/candidate acceptance.

findings.issue: Rollback reports legacy restored even when all system commands fail.
findings.evidence: In-memory fault injection returned legacy_swap_and_tmp_underlay_restored with returncode=1 and boot_swap_stop exception.
findings.required: Check every restore operation, retain recovery artifacts on failure, verify swap/fstab/tmp state before reporting restoration.

findings.issue: Exact path comparison ignores a /dev/dm-N alias of the encrypted mapper.
findings.evidence: Synthetic /dev/dm-7 row made start reject active mapper and stop omit swapoff. Actual kernel representation for this new target was not tested live.
findings.required: Compare canonical block-device identity and test aliases.

findings.issue: Ordering with tmp.mount and local-fs.target can cycle because tmpfs mounts have an automatic After=swap.target dependency.
findings.evidence: Source-derived dependency cycle: swap.target -> tmp.mount -> local-fs.target -> encrypted-swap.service -> swap.target. Bare unit-file verify does not prove the enabled boot graph.
findings.required: Remove cycle and validate enabled target graph in isolation.

findings.issue: Holder scan omits writable mmap after fd close and has no post-mount underlay identity verification; zero holders is recorded as a constant.
findings.required: Quiesce writers, include mapped-file references, verify the hidden underlay after mount, and record measured results.

findings.issue: A crash after legacy swap/fstab change but before final receipt leaves apply rejected and rollback unable to find the receipt.
findings.required: Write durable intent and phases before changes; provide reconciliation and safe recovery for partial mapper creation.

remaining_scope: FR-06 stays in progress. C5C1 runtime prerequisites, C5D protected source checks and guarded operational acceptance, and C5E remaining safety fixes are separate. The canonical project event journal records later exact-commit CI and source synchronization results. Deferred owner scope is unchanged.
